# GamiBar

GamiBar is a web-based live gamified learning platform for classrooms, universities, and training sessions. Educators and session authors create an activity, share a six-digit room code or QR link, and control when all participants begin.

## Product

- Quiz Challenge: live multiple-choice questions ranked by accuracy and completion speed.
- Jigsaw Mission: participants reconstruct an uploaded image as a timed visual puzzle.
- Connect Dots: participants connect matching color pairs on the same path-finding board.
- Live sessions: participants can join from a modern phone, tablet, or desktop browser without creating an account.
- Real-time results: authors can monitor participation and live rankings during a session.
